look_up_card.description: Find out about a payment card from its first 6 to 8 digits: the network (Visa, Mastercard...), whether it is debit or credit, the card brand, whether it is prepaid, the country it was issued in and the issuing bank. Useful for spotting prepaid or foreign cards before accepting a payment. Unknown digits come back with 'found' set to false rather than failing the step. No API key required.

mock_response.summary: Visa debit card from Jyske Bank A/S, Denmark

look_up_card.name: look_up_card

parameters.description: The first 6 to 8 digits of the card. Spaces and hyphens are fine. You can paste a whole card number: only its first 8 digits are sent.
parameters.name: card_number

bank.description: The bank that issued the card.

city.description: The issuing bank's city, when binlist knows it.

name.description: The issuing bank's name, e.g. 'Jyske Bank A/S'.

phone.description: The issuing bank's phone number, when binlist knows it.

website.description: The issuing bank's website, when binlist knows it.

bin.description: The digits that were looked up: the card's first 6 to 8 digits.

brand.description: The card product, e.g. 'Visa Classic/Dankort' or 'World Elite'.

card_type.description: 'debit' or 'credit'. Empty when binlist does not know.

country.description: The country the card was issued in.

currency.description: The three-letter code of the country's currency, e.g. 'DKK'. This is the country's currency, not necessarily the card's.

latitude.description: A rough latitude for the middle of the country.

longitude.description: A rough longitude for the middle of the country.

name.description: The country the card was issued in, e.g. 'Denmark'.

numeric_code.description: The country's three-digit numeric code, e.g. '208'.

found.description: True when binlist knows this card. False means it has no record of these digits, and every other detail is empty.

network.description: The card network, e.g. 'Visa', 'Mastercard' or 'American Express'.

prepaid.description: True for a prepaid card, false for one that is not. Empty when binlist does not know.

summary.description: One line describing the card, e.g. 'Visa debit card from Jyske Bank A/S, Denmark', or saying that no card was found.

description: Look up a payment card from its first 6 to 8 digits (its BIN): the card network, debit or credit, the card brand, whether it is prepaid, the country it was issued in and the issuing bank. Handy for fraud checks and for routing payments. No account or API key required.
